title: Sling: pre-flight walkaround
briefing: The Sling 2 is parked at 1N7 runway 07 with its pitot cover, wheel chocks, and tie-down ropes fitted. Walk the pre-flight inspection of POH section 4.4 in order: cabin, fuselage, empennage, right wing and main gear, nose section and nose gear, then the left wing. Each item shows what to check; the figure does it for you. Take the covers, chocks, and ropes off, and physically look at the fuel level in both tanks: with 30 litres, fuel just covers the bottom of a tank. Ignition off before touching the propeller. This is simulated practice, not a substitute for the aircraft's own handbook.
